 By WSOCTV.com News Staff October 30, 2026 at 10:51 am EDT Enter Fullscreen Expand South Carolina SNAP changes take effect Sunday By WSOCTV.com News Staff October 30, 2026 at 10:51 am EDT COLUMBIA, S.C. — Starting Sunday, people in South Carolina who use SNAP benefits can no longer use their cards to buy sugary drinks and candy.
 READ MORE: South Carolina aims to reduce obesity rates with new SNAP restrictions Diet and zero-sugar soft drinks will remain eligible.
 Program leaders say the change is designed to encourage healthier food choices among SNAP recipients.
 Benefit amounts and eligibility will not change.
